topic: The 52-week savings challenge vs waiting to save nothing (Bram vs Etta)

scenes.narration: Adding one dollar more each week turns into nearly fourteen hundred by December. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a savings jar with fifty two coin slots, comic burst banner reads FOURTEEN HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bram and Etta both want to save but feel broke.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man bram and woman etta in gym gear staring at empty wallets, comic banner reads FEELING BROKE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neither one has ever built a real savings cushion before now.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bram and etta beside an empty glass jar on a gym bench labeled NO SAVINGS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bram waits for one big month to start saving hard.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bram lounging on a gym mat pointing at a distant calendar labeled SOMEDAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That perfect month never arrives, so he keeps saving nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, bram beside an empty jar in the gym, a crossed out calendar stamped NEVER ARRIVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Etta starts the fifty-two week challenge the very first Monday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, etta dropping a coin into a gym jar labeled WEEK ONE, a chart titled FIFTY TWO WEEK CHALLENGE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Week one she saves one dollar, week two saves two.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, etta by a gym locker with two jars stamped ONE DOLLAR and TWO DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each week she adds just one more dollar than before.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, etta on a gym mat filling a rising row of jars, a stepped chart labeled PLUS ONE WEEKLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: By late December Bram still has zero dollars set aside.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked bram in the gym holding an empty jar stamped ZERO SAVED, a December calendar behind him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Etta finished with one thousand three hundred seventy eight dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, etta hugging an overflowing gym jar labeled THIRTEEN SEVENTY EIGHT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That nearly painless jar became her first real emergency fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, etta setting the full jar on a gym shelf relabeled EMERGENCY FUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Start at one dollar and add one dollar weekly. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
